ServicesPrices in US dollars

Services and prices.

Nine services, each with an example, a starting price and a deposit. Every project starts with a brief, a meeting and a written quote.

01Service

Web platforms and apps

Learning platforms, client portals, marketplaces and landing pages, with database, accounts, payments and an optional second language.

Example: Uplink IT Academy: seven modules, exam sets, a ticket simulator and labs, with Stripe payments.

  • Written scope and sitemap
  • Design system and mobile-first screens
  • Database, sign-in and payments
  • Launch on your domain, with documentation
from $4,500per platform; landing pages from $1,500
02Service

Building with AI, coached

Hands-on coaching for founders and teams who want to design, build and deploy products with AI assistants.

Example: The method used for every platform in this portfolio, applied to your project.

  • Your project set up and deployed during the sessions
  • A written playbook of the method
  • Prompts and checklists
  • One week of email follow-up
from $120per hour; half-day workshop $600
03Service

Network design, installation and documentation

Complete site networks: WiFi coverage, switching, cameras, door access, rack and cabling, drawn on your floor plans, installed and documented.

Example: Office and venue deployments, each delivered with a 10-page project book.

  • Site survey and floor plan review
  • Design drawings and coverage maps
  • Bill of materials with list prices
  • Installation, configuration and handover
  • Project book in PDF
from $5,000per site; design and documentation only from $500
04Service

Training content, labs and exam practice

Scenario questions with explanations, self-grading labs, ticket scenarios and courses for IT, security and civic education.

Example: 200-question practice sets, scripted Cisco and Linux labs, and a ticket simulator.

  • Outline mapped to the exam objectives
  • Original questions, labs or lessons
  • Automatic grading for every lab
  • Delivered in your platform or mine
from $900per module

Book editing and production

From manuscript or notes to a finished book: structure, editing, layout, figures, print-ready PDF and ebook, in French or English.

Example: Two illustrated technical books of more than 200 pages, and a 265-page method book.

  • Structural and line editing
  • Interior layout with figures
  • Cover design
  • Print-ready PDF and ebook files
from $600editing; full production from $1,500

Explainer animations, product motion and one-minute social edits in 16:9 and 9:16, captioned, in French and English.

  • 16:9 and 9:16 versions
  • Captions and end card
  • Source files on request
from $350per motion piece; one-minute edit from $150; 10 edits $1,200

Content systems for social media

A publishing system for your brand: carousels, scripts, a calendar, a review queue on your phone, and a playbook.

from $800per month

A bilingual receptionist that answers every call, books appointments, drafts quotes and follows up by text. Set up and managed for you.

Example: Riva, built for businesses that cannot answer the phone while they work.
